name: Privatzimmer Gander
beschreibung:
Overview

The Privatzimmer Gander – also known as Privatpension Gander – is a small private accommodation in the centre of Kufstein in Tyrol. It is located at Weissachstraße 33 in the Weissach/Mitterndorf district, only a few minutes' walk from the famous Kufstein Fortress and the old town. The accommodation is listed in the directories as an inn or private guesthouse and is therefore a typical representative of Tyrol's family-run private-room tradition. Guests can reach the house by telephone at +43 5372 65539. With around eight beds, the establishment is one of the small, manageable houses of the town, where personal contact is the main focus.

No reliable information about the history of the house has been handed down in publicly accessible sources. What is documented is that it is a private guesthouse in Kufstein that is listed in the region's tourism and hotel directories. The name Gander points to a family-run accommodation, as is characteristic of Tyrolean private-room and inn culture. More precise historical details, such as a founding year or the owner's history, cannot be taken from the available sources and are therefore not claimed.

Getting there

The accommodation is located in the urban area of Kufstein at Weissachstraße 33, postal code 6330. Kufstein is a central transport hub on the Inn and can be reached via the railway line and the Inntal motorway; the town centre and the fortress are within walking distance of the accommodation. According to the directory information, guests arriving by car have access to the establishment's own parking lot. Kufstein railway station is located in the urban area. Precise opening or check-in times are not publicly documented; contacting the establishment in advance by telephone at +43 5372 65539 is therefore recommended.

Tips

As this is a small private guesthouse, prices are available on request – the establishment does not publish binding rates in the sources. According to the directories, payment on site is made in cash in euros, and the staff speak German. According to this information, the house does not operate its own restaurant; however, restaurants and cafés serving regional cuisine are located in the immediate surroundings of the central location. For a stay, booking in advance by telephone is worthwhile, as capacity is limited to around eight beds. The location is convenient as a starting point for excursions to Kufstein Fortress and the surrounding mountain world.
